name: MSc Physics Laboratory - II
description: In this lab course, the students are exposed to a set of advanced experimental methods in physics. Various techniques based on interferometry and transport measurement that form the basis of modern precision measurement are introduced. A selection of experiments based on atomic physics, plasma physics, optics, and condensed matter physics demonstrate important basic concepts studied in various lecture courses.
